name: The Herbalist's Knowledge
description: Elian said the Herbalist, Elara, might know something. I should find her and ask about a 'cure' for Lian.

1.name: Ask Elara about the cure
1.description: Elara is the village's expert on herbs and lore. She's the only one who might know of a way to help Lian.

fail_response.content: I'm sorry, but I don't discuss such serious matters with those I've only just met. Perhaps we can speak later, after we are better acquainted.
